pmpm_source_note: National-average PMPM assumption from public CMS/MedPAC reporting (2026 MA county benchmark example ~$1,279/month; MedPAC-estimated MA payments ~14% above FFS; average rebates ~$222/enrollee/month). Not the actual per-county CMS ratebook -- a single national PMPM is applied to every member, which is the main precision limitation of this proxy.
